# Remove From Album

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Removes an image from an album.

## Syntax

~~~~text
removeFromAlbum(image: <#Variable (Optional)#>, album: <#Album (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
removeFromAlbum(image: avatar, album: a-Profiles)
~~~~
